items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Hackett and I the other night tried to remember Benny Harris' name

ctx.x: Okay, but any way, now that tune came about because when we would play 'How High the Moon', that was Benny Harris' solo, the trumpet player.
Bobby Hackett and I the other night tried to remember Benny Harris' name and it came up two days later.
